title: 📌 National Flagship Schemes — PMMSY Mayabunder Harbour (₹199.24 Cr), PMMVY 9 Yrs & BBBP 11 Yrs
summary: PMMVY completed 9 years on 1st January 2026 (launched 1 Jan 2017). Provides cash benefit of ₹5,000 for the first child (₹3,000 on registration, ₹2,000 after childbirth) and ₹6,000 for the second girl child. Eligible beneficiaries also receive cash incentive under Janani Suraksha Yojana. Over 4.5 crore beneficiaries enrolled with >₹19,000 crore disbursed.

items: **Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY) Completes Nine Years** (Page 2): PMMVY completed 9 years on 1st January 2026 (launched 1 Jan 2017). Provides cash benefit of ₹5,000 for the first child (₹3,000 on registration, ₹2,000 after childbirth) and ₹6,000 for the second girl child. Eligible beneficiaries also receive cash incentive under Janani Suraksha Yojana. Over 4.5 crore beneficiaries enrolled with >₹19,000 crore disbursed.

**Beti Bachao Beti Padhao Campaign Completes 11 Years (Sex Ratio at Birth at 930)** (Page 8): BBBP completed 11 years on 22 Jan 2026 (launched 2015 in Panipat). National Sex Ratio at Birth improved to 930 from 918 in 2014-15. Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana offers 8.2% interest for girl child up to 10 years.

**MoF Approves ₹199.24 Crore PMMSY Smart Fishing Harbour at Mayabunder, A&N** (Page 11): Department of Fisheries approved ₹199.24 crore 100% CFA under PMMSY for Smart and Integrated Fishing Harbour at Mayabunder under Blue Port Initiative, handling 430 vessels and 10,000 tonnes of fish annually to support ₹1L Cr seafood export target by 2030-31.

**MoRTH Notifies Rah-Veer Good Samaritan Scheme (₹25,000 Reward for Golden Hour Help)** (Page 62): MoRTH notified Rah-Veer scheme under Sec 134A of MV Act 2019 offering ₹25,000 cash reward and appreciation certificate up to 5 times/year for saving accident victims in Golden Hour.

blocks.title: 🎯 Exam Focus & Pitfalls
blocks.content: Pay close attention to statutory outlays, regulatory deadlines, and institutional authority under Central Sector Welfare Schemes & Port Infrastructure. ₹199.24 Cr PMMSY Mayabunder Blue Port, 9 years of PMMVY (4.5 Cr mothers, ₹19k Cr), 11 years of BBBP (SRB 930), and Rah-Veer Good Samaritan ₹25k award.
